summary: Backend-only, offline. I ran NO new generation (no POST to /tryon/generate, /outfit/* or /retry). The only API calls were read-only GETs with pending_test_tok: /auth/me, /tryons/5e2eb532 and the result file, all 200. (1) I compared the existing result 349f217b.jpg with the original avatar e2bf1a90.bin, downscaled to 1536 as in _fashn_render (tests/surgical_result_analyse.py). Face, hair, background, legs and the free hand match the original pixel for pixel (mean diff 0.2-0.6, which is only JPEG noise). The chest-skin rectangle around the phone hand is GONE: the hand sits on the black tee, its 4 visible fingers are original pixels (the thumb is hidden behind the phone, as in the original), and no new bare skin appears (0.22% of the image). Remaining defects in this stored image: (a) the skin 'bib' band between the chin/neck and the tee collar is still there. This is expected, because the image was made before the ellipse fix. The engine output was saved under a random tryon_raw path that is not recorded anywhere, so I could not re-merge it with the new code. (b) The lower half of the phone (between the collar and the fingers) is painted over by the tee or a brown smear, so the phone looks cut off. (c) A small patch of the original chest tattoo and a light soft halo show along the top-right edge of the hand. (2) New synthetic tests (tests/test_surgical_fashn_unit.py, 15 tests): 13 pass, 2 fail. The 2 failures are real findings (the phone, and the poll error mapping). Confirmed: the face stays original up to 0.93 of face height and blends into the result between 0.96 and 1.02. At 1.05 (inside the old 0.80 ellipse) the pixels now come from the result, so the bib is fixed. Ghost hair next to the head above the chin stays original. A top_free -1 hand box keeps the hand skin and lets the chest around it become the tee (top_free 0 would paste the rectangle back). New skin holes in the new tee are blocked. (3) The 4 existing unit test files: 18 passed, 7 skipped. The skips are for missing local fixture images, not for live generation. (4) Code review: owner gating and the single submit with no retry are correct. Shoes/bag-only gives 422 with no engine call. A TryOnError on garment 1 gives 502, garment 2 is never sent, nothing is stored and no tryon doc is created.

minor.issue: Only skin pixels inside the hand box are locked. The held phone is not skin, so the engine's tee or smear replaces the lower half of the phone (seen in the real result; the synthetic test test_held_phone_inside_hand_box_kept fails with out=[15,15,15]). This breaks the 'only clothing changes' rule. Possible fix: inside the hand box also lock pixels that were NOT skin in the original and are not skin-coloured in the result, unless the original pixel was garment. A simpler fix is to lock the original phone region (a non-skin, non-garment blob that touches the hand).

'Skin in BOTH images' also locks original CHEST skin wherever the engine drew its hand slightly larger or shifted. Result: a small patch of the original chest tattoo and a light halo along the top-right edge of the hand on the black tee. Possible fix: erode the hand-lock mask by a few px, or require the original skin pixel to be connected to the hand core and not the chest.

s.raise_for_status() on the status poll, requests.get(img url) and its raise_for_status, and a ConnectionError or Timeout on the submit POST all raise requests exceptions, not TryOnError. _fashn_render does not catch them, so the user gets a generic 500 'Generazione interrotta' instead of the 502 message (test_fashn_poll_http_error_is_not_tryon_error fails). Wrap them in TryOnError, and keep the submit un-retried.

surgical_merge raises ValueError('no face in original') AFTER a paid generation, so the user gets a 500 and the credit is spent. Check for a face before submitting, or fall back to the raw engine output with only the no-new-skin lock.
The 502 detail always says 'Nessun credito usato'. For a multi-garment outfit where garment 1 succeeded and garment 2 failed, Universal Key credit was already spent.

The tryon_raw path is random and not saved in the tryon doc, so a result cannot be re-merged offline after a mask fix without a new generation (this blocked verifying the bib fix on the real image). Store raw_path in the tryon/outfit doc.

Always labels the image as image/jpeg, but for the 2nd garment of an outfit the person image is the engine's PNG output. downscale can also return PNG for RGBA input. Detect the mime from magic bytes.

action_items: Lock the held phone (non-skin object) inside the phone-hand box so the garment does not paint over it
Tighten the hand skin lock (erode or connect to the hand core) so no original chest tattoo or halo shows around the hand
Map every requests exception in fashn.tryon (poll, result, image download, submit network error) to TryOnError, so the user gets 502 and not 500
Check for a face before submitting to FASHN (surgical_merge ValueError comes after a paid generation)
Save tryon_raw path in the tryon doc so merges can be checked offline without regenerating
The bib fix is verified only with synthetic tests. The real image still shows the bib because it predates the fix; verify on the next user-approved generation
critical_code_review_comments: Owner gating OK: _owner_extra returns '' for non-owners (email check is case-insensitive), so SURGICAL_RULE is never present and FASHN is never reached. All 3 entry points (tryon_generate, outfit generate and grid, retry) go through _owner_extra.

One generation per garment OK: one requests.post per fashn.tryon call, no retry loop around the submit (only GET polling retries on network errors). _fashn_render loops garments once and stops at the first error.

Errors leave no trace OK: the tryon doc and try_on_log are inserted only after _render_single returns. _fashn_render returns before the generic 'except Exception' wrapper, so 422/402/502 keep their status codes.
server.py is 3649 lines: split the render/try-on code into its own module
seed_data_creation: None. No generation, no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do NOT trigger generations without user approval. Run `python tests/surgical_result_analyse.py` to compare any surgical result with its original (edit the ORIG and RES paths; crops go to /tmp/sa_*.jpg). Hand boxes for the avatar e2bf1a90 are in db.hand_boxes: [275,555,374,696] (phone, right hand) and [583,382,668,458]. Face box at 1536 scale: (607,135,143,199). The synthetic tests in test_surgical_fashn_unit.py fail on purpose for the phone lock and the poll exception mapping until those are fixed.
rca of the issue: Chest rectangle: the old hand freeze locked the whole padded box to original pixels; top_free -1 now locks only skin in both images, which is verified fixed. Bib: the old head ellipse (0.80 fh, ending at fy+1.10fh) and the above-chin zone (radius 1.15fh, not cut) kept the original bare neck and upper chest under the chin. The new 0.68 fh ellipse and the zone cut at fy+0.95fh give a measured transition at 0.96-1.02 fh. Phone cut: the hand lock only looks at skin, so the non-skin phone pixels in the engine's 'changed' mask take the engine output.
